"''Then ''blast'' him, you idiot!|Lok Durd chastises an OOM command battle droid|audio=LokDurd5.flac|{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}}} During the [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|Defense of Maridun]], this '''[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]''', under command of [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] led the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attack on the [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] village. He was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. ==History== When Separatist forces were sent to [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] to test a new weapon, this droid was part of the task force. He informed [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] of the defenses of the Lurmen village. In the ensuing fight the droid was destroyed in his [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with masculine programming]] [[Category:OOM command battle droids]] [[Category:Separatist officers]]
